title: Return-Rate Multiplier on Returns & Exchanges Shoebox Fees
content:
A high return rate raises the Returns & Exchanges shoebox fee per unit on returned footwear. The multiplier applies only to a customer whose Marlowe Rewards membership is in status active.

| Customer | Return rate | Multiplier on the shoebox fee per unit |
|---|---|---|
| Marlowe Rewards membership in status active | 0.5 or more | 2 |
| Marlowe Rewards membership in status active | 0.2 or more, below 0.5 | 1.5 |
| Marlowe Rewards membership in status active | Below 0.2 | Not multiplied |
| No membership in status active | Any | Not multiplied |

## Both sides of each threshold

| Return rate (active membership) | Multiplier |
|---|---|
| 0.5 | 2 |
| 0.49 | 1.5 |
| 0.2 | 1.5 |
| 0.19 | Not multiplied |

Example (hypothetical): an active member with a return rate of 0.6 has a box amount of 6.00 multiplied to 12.00.
